source_name: Banka Slovenije - Objave / Sporočila za javnost (press releases & announcements hub)
why_relevant: Central, filterable feed of all Bank of Slovenia announcements: press releases, banking-system status notes, publications, speeches, digital euro. Primary chronological signal for regulatory and payments news in Slovenia. English mirror exists at /en/media/news.

source_name: Banka Slovenije - Publikacije (publications catalogue)
why_relevant: Master catalogue of recurring BS publications: Letno poročilo, Poročilo o finančni stabilnosti, Pregled makroekonomskih gibanj, Mesečni bilten, Poročilo o delovanju plačilnega sistema. The backbone of periodic banking/payments intelligence.

source_name: Banka Slovenije - Predvideni datumi objav publikacij (release calendar)
why_relevant: Advance release calendar lets the collector schedule polling precisely around statistical and report releases instead of blind daily crawling; also enumerates the full publication set.

source_name: Banka Slovenije - Nadzorniška razkritja in seznami (supervisory disclosures, CRD Art. 143/144; ZBan-3 Art. 307/308)
why_relevant: The legally compelled supervisory-disclosure layer: rules and options applied, supervisory approaches, aggregate banking-sector statistics, and the lists of supervised entities. Directly comparable across EU member states.

source_name: Banka Slovenije - Izrečeni ukrepi (supervisory measures and sanctions issued to banks)
why_relevant: Named enforcement actions and sanctions against banks and responsible persons, published once proceedings conclude. High-signal for compliance risk, AML failures, and vendor/process weaknesses at specific institutions.

source_name: Banka Slovenije - Register subjektov nadzora (register of supervised entities)
why_relevant: Authoritative enumeration of every licensed bank, savings bank, branch, payment institution and e-money institution supervised in Slovenia. The canonical actor map that seeds every other workstream; each entry has its own detail page.

source_name: Banka Slovenije - Register družb za izdajo elektronskega denarja (e-money institution register, ZPlaSSIED)
why_relevant: Statutory register of licensed and waiver-regime e-money issuers, their agents and branches in host and third countries. Direct actor map for the Slovenian payments/fintech layer.

source_name: Banka Slovenije - EEA passported payment institutions and e-money institutions operating in Slovenia
why_relevant: Lists foreign EEA payment and e-money institutions passported into Slovenia - the competitive layer that never appears in domestic company registers. Essential for a true payments market map.

source_name: Banka Slovenije - Nadzor nebančnih ponudnikov plačilnih storitev in infrastruktur finančnega trga
why_relevant: Oversight hub for non-bank PSPs and financial market infrastructures - the regulatory frame governing acquirers, processors and scheme operators that Printec-type vendors sell into.

source_name: Banka Slovenije - Statistika plačil / payment statistics releases
why_relevant: Semi-annual payment statistics (transaction counts and values by instrument, cards, POS/ATM, e-money) plus financial-institution statistics. The quantitative baseline for payments market sizing in Slovenia.

source_name: Banka Slovenije - Stanje v bančnem sistemu (monthly banking system information)
why_relevant: Monthly key aggregates on the Slovenian banking system (balance sheet, loans, deposits, profitability). Highest-frequency official signal on sector health; anticipates bank earnings narratives.

source_name: Banka Slovenije - Poročilo o delovanju plačilnega sistema (payment system operation report)
why_relevant: Reporting framework and outputs on payment-system operation - definitional authority on what PSPs must report, and thus on what data will exist downstream.

source_name: Banka Slovenije - Finančni omejevalni ukrepi (financial restrictive measures / sanctions compliance)
why_relevant: Sanctions-compliance expectations placed on Slovenian banks and PSPs; drives screening/AML technology demand and is a recurring supervisory-priority theme.

source_name: Banka Slovenije - Prijava kršitev (whistleblowing channel page)
why_relevant: Reveals indirectly which entity types BS considers itself to supervise and which breach categories it prioritises; low direct content value but useful for scoping supervisory perimeter.

source_name: ATVP (Agencija za trg vrednostnih papirjev) - Nadzorovani subjekti: javne družbe
why_relevant: List of Slovenian public companies (issuers) subject to periodic disclosure - includes the listed banks and insurers whose annual/half-year reports and IR flow are the A1 target. Companion page lists investment-service providers.

source_name: OAM - Officially Appointed Mechanism (ATVP register of issuers' regulated information)
why_relevant: The statutory central storage of regulated information: audited annual reports, half-year reports and other disclosures of Slovenian issuers, free to access. Highest-value single endpoint for A1 disclosure/annual-report collection.

source_name: ATVP - Izrečeni ukrepi (supervisory measures issued)
why_relevant: Published enforcement decisions and summaries under ZTFI-1/ZUAIS/AML, naming supervised firms. Signals market-conduct and AML pressure on brokers, fund managers and issuers.

source_name: ATVP - Poročanje v enotni elektronski obliki (ESEF reporting)
why_relevant: Defines the machine-readable (iXBRL/ESEF) format in which Slovenian issuers must file annual financial reports - directly determines whether annual reports can be parsed structurally rather than as PDFs.

source_name: ATVP - Letna poročila agencije + Katalog informacij javnega značaja
why_relevant: ATVP's own annual reports give market statistics, supervision workload and enforcement counts; the Katalog IJZ enumerates every register and dataset the agency holds - a strong pointer for further discovery and FOI requests.

source_name: ATVP - Enotna vstopna točka za izdajatelje / prospekti (prospectus approval)
why_relevant: Prospectus approvals reveal capital-raising by Slovenian banks and financial firms before it reaches press coverage; the issuer single-entry-point section also maps the capital-markets financing pipeline.

source_name: AZN (Agencija za zavarovalni nadzor) - Letna poročila agencije
why_relevant: Statutory annual report to the National Assembly (by 30 June) on the state of the Slovenian insurance market, with market statistics and supervisory activity. Core for the bancassurance/insurance side of 'sector=both'. PDF archive back to at least 2017.

source_name: AZN - Register zastopnikov in posrednikov + Stališča in obvestila agencije
why_relevant: Public register of insurance agents/brokers plus the agency's positions and notices - actor map for the distribution layer (including bank-owned agencies) and running supervisory-opinion feed.

source_name: AZN - Poročanje zavarovalnic in pokojninskih družb (reporting requirements & disclosures)
why_relevant: Defines what insurers and pension companies must report/disclose (incl. Solvency II SFCR-type disclosures), and therefore what standardised financial data on Slovenian insurers will exist.

source_name: Informacijski pooblaščenec (IPRS) - decisions on FOI appeals against Banka Slovenije
why_relevant: The Information Commissioner's decision search reveals what supervisory information BS and other regulators have withheld or been ordered to release - a route to non-published documents and a map of confidentiality boundaries.

source_name: AJPES JOLP – Javna objava letnih poročil (public disclosure of annual reports)
why_relevant: Statutory single point where every Slovenian company, cooperative, bank, insurer and sole trader files its annual report; free full-text/PDF access to the last five business years. This is the canonical artefact store for A1 annual reports and financial statements for banks, payment institutions and their POS/IT suppliers alike.

source_name: AJPES – Letna in druga poročila: seznam poročil (list of report types by entity class)
why_relevant: Enumerates which report types (audited annual report, consolidated report, bank/insurer specific forms) are publicly disclosed for which legal form. Essential for knowing what artefact to expect for a bank vs a d.o.o. payments vendor before designing collection.

source_name: AJPES – Koledar javne objave letnih poročil (disclosure calendar)
why_relevant: Publishes the dates on which each tranche of annual reports becomes public (e.g. mass disclosure for FY2025 reported in early August 2026). Lets a collector schedule crawls instead of polling blindly.

source_name: AJPES ePRS – Poslovni register Slovenije (Business Register search, incl. by SKD activity)
why_relevant: Central register of all Slovenian legal entities; basic search supports filtering by SKD (NACE) main activity code and institutional sector, which is exactly how one enumerates the banking (64.19), holding/other financial (64/65/66.19) and payment-services universe before pulling their filings.
